title: Understanding the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix $X$ is constructed using the features of the data. In this case, the features are $(x_{i1})**{3}$ and $\log(x_{i2})$.

title: Rank of the Design Matrix
text: The rank of a matrix is the maximum number of linearly independent column vectors in the matrix. For Wesley's model, the rank of the design matrix $X$ should be less than or equal to the number of features.

title: Unique Solution in OLS
text: For a unique solution in Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), the design matrix $X$ must have full column rank. This means the columns of $X$ should be linearly independent.

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: Given $$\$n=30\$$$ data points and $$2$$ features, check if the columns of the design matrix $X$ are linearly independent.

title: Conclusion on Rank
text: Since Wesley has $$2$$ features and $$30$$ data points, the rank of the design matrix $X$ is $$2$$, which is less than $$3$$. Therefore, the statement about the rank being less than $$3$$ is true.
